study_info.title: Calcitriol Treatment Is Not Effective in Postmenopausal Osteoporosis
study_info.authors: Susan M. Ott, MD; and Charles H. Chesnut III, MD
study_info.study_design: Double-blind, randomized clinical trial. Randomization was performed by providing each woman a bottle of capsules (calcitriol or placebo) that had been randomized by the supplier (Hoffmann-La Roche). The method of randomization is not further specified.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Postmenopausal women, age 50-80, with at least two vertebral compression fractures (>15% reduction in anterior height) without history of serious trauma, white, ambulatory, not taking medications for osteoporosis (except calcium supplements in some cases), and with normal laboratory test results.
study_info.exclusion_criteria: History of corticosteroid use, malnutrition, sarcoidosis, liver disease, rheumatoid arthritis, nephrolithiasis, renal disease, or recent malignancy.
study_info.dropout_reasons: Four women on calcitriol discontinued the study within 12 weeks for personal reasons. Four others discontinued after a year; 1 for personal reasons and 1 for multiple fractures; 1 was placed on corticosteroids for a pulmonary disease, and 1 developed clinical signs of chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Six women receiving placebo discontinued within 6 months: 4 for personal reasons, 1 for severe depression, and 1 woman died of a myocardial infarction.

minimal_units.intervention_details: Calcitriol capsules, starting dose 0.25 μg twice daily, titrated up to a maximum of 8 capsules daily (mean dose 0.70 ± 0.07 μg/d at 12 weeks and 0.43 ± 0.03 μg/d at 96 weeks), with dietary calcium 1000 mg/d (24.9 mmol/d), both adjusted for hypercalciuria or hypercalcemia.
minimal_units.intervention_frequency: Started at one capsule twice daily, titrated every 2 weeks as needed

outcomes.domain_match: Matches all-cause mortality domain; one death (myocardial infarction) reported in placebo group, none in calcitriol group.

minimal_units.control_details: Placebo capsules identical in appearance to calcitriol, with dietary calcium 1000 mg/d (24.9 mmol/d), both adjusted for hypercalciuria or hypercalcemia.

outcomes.domain_match: Matches all-cause mortality domain; one death (myocardial infarction) in placebo group reported.
Matches myocardial infarction domain; one fatal myocardial infarction in placebo group reported.

meta_analysis_parameters.outcome_domain: major adverse cardiovascular events；myocardial infarction；stroke or cerebrovascular events；cardiovascular disease mortality；all-cause mortality
